notes.title: Game Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
Nyan Cat: Lost In Space receives yet another update!

Patch notes:
- Warrior achievement now requires only 10 enemies to be taken care of
- Veteran achievement has been made easier with a requirement of 100 enemies eliminated
- UFO Visitor has also been made easier and now needs 25 UFO abduction survives
- City Boy achievement had a minor issue that has been fixed

notes.title: Game Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
Nyan Cat: Lost In Space is back with another update!

Patch notes:
- Some of the missions have been fixed and now working as intended
- Holding down the right mouse button in Nyan Wings won't hide the land from now on
- Progression notifications have been added for the longer achievements
- Safe Nyan achievement has been fixed

Please keep in mind that almost all of the Runtime Error messages can be fixed manually by installing Visual C++ Redistributable 2013 or OpenAL. Read more about these in the our Bug Report Thread.

notes.title: Xmas and the stormtroopers are on us!
notes.content:
Create your Nyanmas or Nyan Wars themed custom skins in Nyan Cat: Lost In Space and share them with us by using the steam screenshot upload feature!

Also please give a thumbs up to the skins you prefer, because the one having most likes by the 25th of December will be posted on the official Nyan Cat site with the name of its maker! 

#nyanmas

notes.title: Game Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
A new version of Nyan Cat: Lost In Space is now available.

Patch notes:
- All players are now correctly appearing on the leaderboards
- Unicode characters are now replaced with a * character instead of a blank
- The background of the leaderboards have been fixed
- Descriptions for the different game modes have been added
